info.title: Archneter CLI
info.description: Archneter is an enterprise-grade command-line interface (CLI) designed to accelerate .NET application development. Built on Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, it automates the scaffolding of highly cohesive, scalable software architectures—including Clean Architecture, Microservices, Modular Monoliths, Vertical Slices, and N-Tier solutions. Empower your engineering teams to establish standardized, production-ready project foundations instantly.

commands.name: refactor
commands.description: Analyze and refactor an existing .NET project into a target architecture

options.name: --arch
options.description:
Architecture template to generate
clean            → Clean Architecture (default)
microservices    → Microservices
n-tier           → N-Tier (PL → BLL → DAL)
verticalslice    → Vertical Slice
modularmonolith  → Modular Monolith

options.name: --services
options.description:
Comma-separated service names (microservices only)
e.g. Order,Product,Identity

options.name: --modules
options.description:
Comma-separated module names (modular monolith only)
e.g. Sales,Catalog,Inventory

options.name: --features
options.description:
Comma-separated feature names (vertical slice only)
e.g. Orders,Catalog,Cart

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Preview the generated structure without writing any files
no real dotnet commands run, nothing is created on disk
For 'refactor':

options.name: --to
options.description:
Target architecture (required)
clean            → Clean Architecture (.Domain / .Application / .Infrastructure / .Api)
verticalslice    → Vertical Slice (feature-sliced folders inside one Web API)
modularmonolith  → Modular Monolith (.Host / .Shared / .Modules.{X})
microservices    → Microservices (.Gateway / .Shared / .Services.{X}.*)
n-tier           → N-Tier (.DAL / .BLL / .PL)

options.name: --dir
options.description: Root directory of the project to refactor (default: current directory)

options.name: --deep-refactor
options.description: Optional deep refactoring mode (DI extraction & interface generation using Roslyn)
